Commercial Cleaning Remote Cold Caller

Cleanse Cleaning Company

Países permitidosMéxico, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoEnglish (Native or fully fluent)

Salario$5 to $8 USD/hour (~$97 to $155 MXN/hour, negotiable)

Descripción del puesto

Part-time remote cold caller contacting offices, medical buildings, and small businesses to schedule commercial cleaning walk-through appointments.

Funciones principales

  • Cold call offices, medical buildings, and small businesses.
  • Set up commercial cleaning walk-through appointments.
  • Support script refinement and lead list building as needed.

Requisitos

  • Native or fully fluent English.
  • Cold caller with a proven track record of success.
  • Part-time availability; script writing and lead list building are a plus.

Beneficios

  • Negotiable hourly rate of $5 to $8 USD.
  • 100% remote part-time schedule.
